summary: Internal orders dashboard scores 7.55 total — above the 7.0 internal bar. Density is a feature (50+ rows above fold, tabular-nums, tight row height), keyboard-first affordances present, empty state has shape. Top-3 changes still emitted per pull-up principle.

top_changes.change: Add a visible keyboard-shortcut hint near the filter input (a `Kbd` element showing `/`) — currently discoverable only via placeholder text. Small but compounds over 4h/day usage.
Tighten type hierarchy — h1 at text-xl reads flat against the row text-sm. Consider text-base for h1 with a stronger weight (semibold → bold) OR text-2xl to establish scan-level anchor.
Add a subtle skeleton loader on data refresh (Alpine `x-transition` on the tbody) — currently a page-refresh feels like nothing changed until the new rows appear. Perceived latency win.
